#' get a label dict that replaces the posix safe names into printable versions
#' 
#' @returns a label dict that replaces the posix safe names into printable versions
#' label_dict_names <- get_label_dict()
get_label_dict <- function() {
  label_dict <- list()
  # condition combinations
  label_dict[['cUTc24hCA']] <- 'UT-24hCA'
  label_dict[['c24hCAcUT']] <- 'UT-24hCA'
  # conditions
  label_dict[['UT']] <- 'untreated'
  label_dict[['cUT']] <- 'untreated'
  label_dict[['24hCA']] <- '24h Candida'
  label_dict[['c24hCA']] <- '24h Candida'
  # major cell types
  label_dict[["Bulk"]] <- "bulk-like"
  label_dict[["CD4T"]] <- "CD4+ T"
  label_dict[["CD8T"]] <- "CD8+ T"
  label_dict[["monocyte"]] <- "monocyte"
  label_dict[["NK"]] <- "NK"
  label_dict[["B"]] <- "B"
  label_dict[["DC"]] <- "DC"
  label_dict[["HSPC"]] <- "HSPC"
  label_dict[["plasmablast"]] <- "plasmablast"
  label_dict[["platelet"]] <- "platelet"
  label_dict[["T_other"]] <- "other T"
  # minor cell types
  label_dict[["CD4_TCM"]] <- "CD4 TCM"
  label_dict[["Treg"]] <- "T regulatory"
  label_dict[["CD4_Naive"]] <- "CD4 naive"
  label_dict[["CD4_CTL"]] <- "CD4 CTL"
  label_dict[["CD8_TEM"]] <- "CD8 TEM"
  label_dict[["cMono"]] <- "cMono"
  label_dict[["CD8_TCM"]] <- "CD8 TCM"
  label_dict[["ncMono"]] <- "ncMono"
  label_dict[["cDC2"]] <- "cDC2"
  label_dict[["B_intermediate"]] <- "B intermediate"
  label_dict[["NKdim"]] <- "NK dim"
  label_dict[["pDC"]] <- "pDC"
  label_dict[["ASDC"]] <- "ASDC"
  label_dict[["CD8_Naive"]] <- "CD8 naive"
  label_dict[["MAIT"]] <- "MAIT"
  label_dict[["CD8_Proliferating"]] <- "CD8 proliferating"
  label_dict[["CD4_TEM"]] <- "CD4 TEM"
  label_dict[["B_memory"]] <- "B memory"
  label_dict[["NKbright"]] <- "NK bright"
  label_dict[["B_naive"]] <- "B naive"
  label_dict[["gdT"]] <- "gamma delta T"
  label_dict[["CD4_Proliferating"]] <- "CD4 proliferating"
  label_dict[["NK_Proliferating"]] <- "NK proliferating"

  label_dict[["dnT"]] <- "double negative T"
  return(label_dict)
}


rename_labels <- function(vector_to_rename) {
  # get the labels that are present
  label_renaming <- get_label_dict()
  # now check which labels we are missing
  missing_renames <- setdiff(unique(vector_to_rename), names(label_renaming))
  # add those renames as not being renames
  for (missing_rename in missing_renames) {
    label_renaming[[missing_rename]] <- missing_rename
  }
  # now replace each value with the rename
  renamed_vector <- as.vector(unlist(label_renaming[vector_to_rename]))
  # and return that
  return(renamed_vector)
}

#' get the LFC for each gene from an output file processed by limma dream
#' 
#' @param mast.output.loc the location of the output file
#' @param p.val.column the column in the file that has the P value to filtr on
#' @param p.val.cutoff the p-value cutoff to use for filtering
#' @returns the filtered table for that output file
#' 
get_gene_and_lfc_limma <- function(limma.output.loc, p.val.column='p.bonferroni', p.val.cutoff=0.05){
  # read the output
  de.output <- read.table(limma.output.loc, header = T, sep = '\t', stringsAsFactors = F)
  # subset to what is significant
  de.output.significant <- de.output[de.output[[p.val.column]] < p.val.cutoff, ]
  return(de.output.significant)
}



#' get the LFC for each gene from an output file created by a DE method
#' 
#' @param de.output.loc the location of the output file
#' @param de_method the DE method used (mast_standalone, mast_seurat or limma)
#' @param p.val.column the column in the file that has the P value to filter on
#' @param p.val.cutoff the p-value cutoff to use for filtering
#' @returns the filtered table for that output file
#' 
get_de_output <- function(de.output.loc, de_method, p.val.column='bonferroni', p.val.cutoff=0.05){
  # use the correct method
  de.output <- NULL
  if (de_method == 'limma'){
    de.output <- get_gene_and_lfc_limma(de.output.loc, p.val.column = p.val.column, p.val.cutoff = p.val.cutoff)
  }
  else{
    print('de_method not valid, valid options are: limma')
  }
  return(de.output)
}

#' get the LFC for each gene from each output file created by a DE method
#' 
#' @param de_output_path the folder containing the DE results
#' @param de_method the DE method used (mast_standalone, mast_seurat or limma)
#' @param p.val.column the column in the file that has the P value to filter on
#' @param p.val.cutoff the p-value cutoff to use for filtering
#' @returns a list of tables per output file, with in each entry a table with the filtered table for that output file
#' 
get_de_genes_per_celltype <- function(de_output_path, de_method, pval_column='p.bonferroni', p_val_cutoff=0.05, pattern='*_condition_final.nominal_significant.tsv.gz$') {
  # list files in directory
  files_dir <- list.files(de_output_path, full.names = T, pattern = pattern)
  # keep track of results per celltype
  results_per_ct <- list()
  # check each file
  for (output_file in files_dir) {
    # get the output
    output <- get_de_output(output_file, de_method = de_method, p.val.column = pval_column, p.val.cutoff = p_val_cutoff)
    # get the basename of the file
    basename_file <- basename(output_file)
    basename_file <- sub(pattern = "(.*?)\\..*$", replacement = "\\1", basename_file)
    # add to the list
    results_per_ct[[basename_file]] <- output
  }
  return(results_per_ct)
}

#' get the number of DE genes per output file
#' 
#' @param de_output_path the DE output table per cell type in a list, with the names being the cell types
#' @param celltype_snip part of the string remove from the cell type annotation to make the name look nicer
#' @param p.val.column the column in the file that has the P value to filter on
#' @param p.val.cutoff the p-value cutoff to use for filtering
#' @returns a table with the 'celltype' as the first column, and the 'number' as the second column
#' 
de_outputs_to_table <- function(de_output_per_celltype, celltype_snip='_condition_final', p_val_column='p.bonferroni', p_val_cutoff=0.05) {
  # create a new dataframe
  nr_df <- data.frame(celltype = rep(NA, times = length(names(de_output_per_celltype))),
                      number = rep(0, times = length(names(de_output_per_celltype))))
  # check each celltype
  for (i in 1:length(names(de_output_per_celltype))) {
    # extract the cell type
    celltype <- names(de_output_per_celltype)[i]
    # extract the results
    output <- de_output_per_celltype[[celltype]]
    # filter by significance
    output <- output[output[[p_val_column]] < p_val_cutoff, ]
    # count how many results
    nr_genes <- nrow(output)
    # snip something from the name if requested
    celltype_snipped <- celltype
    if (!is.null(celltype_snip)) {
      celltype_snipped <- gsub(celltype_snip, '', celltype)
    }
    # add to the dataframe
    nr_df[i, 'celltype'] <- celltype_snipped
    nr_df[i, 'number'] <- nr_genes
  }
  return(nr_df)
}

#' plot in a barplot the number of DE genes per cell type
#' 
#' @param de_numbers the table containing the number of DE genes per cell type
#' @param celltype_column which column of the supplied table has the celltype name
#' @param number_column which column of the supplied table has the number of DE genes
#' @param pointless draw the ticks on the bottom of the plot?
#' @param legendless draw the legend?
#' @param ylim the range for the y-axis
#' @param paper_style use the paper style with more whitespace
#' @param angle_labels angle the x labels 90 degrees?
#' @returns a barplot with the number of DE genes per cell type
#' 
de_gene_numbers_to_plot <- function(de_numbers, celltype_column='celltype', number_column='number', pointless=F, legendless=F, ylim=NULL, paper_style=T, angle_labels=T, use_label_dict=F) {
  # rename labels if requested
  if (use_label_dict) {
    de_numbers[[celltype_column]] <- rename_labels(as.character(de_numbers[[celltype_column]]))
  }
  p <- ggplot(mapping = aes(x = de_numbers[[celltype_column]], y = de_numbers[[number_column]], fill = de_numbers[[celltype_column]])) +
    geom_bar(stat='identity') + xlab(celltype_column) + ylab(number_column)
  # options
  if(!is.null(ylim)){
    p <- p + ylim(ylim)
  }
  if(pointless){
    p <- p + theme(axis.text.x=element_blank(), 
                   axis.ticks = element_blank())
  }
  if(legendless){
    p <- p + theme(legend.position = 'none')
  }
  if (paper_style) {
    p <- p + theme(panel.border = element_rect(color="black", fill=NA, size=1.1), panel.grid.major = element_blank(), panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), panel.background = element_blank(), strip.background = element_rect(colour="white", fill="white"))
  }
  if (angle_labels) {
    p <- p + theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust=1))
  }
  return(p)
}



plot_DE_sharing_per_celltype <- function(de_table_per_ct, feature_column='feature', pval_column='p.bonferroni', sig_pval=0.05, only_positive=F, only_negative=F, lfc_column='metafc', use_label_dict=T, use_color_dict=T){
  DE_genes_per_ct <- list()
  # get the DE genes for each cell type
  for(cell_type in names(de_table_per_ct)){
    # filter to only include the significant results
    de_table <- de_table_per_ct[[cell_type]][de_table_per_ct[[cell_type]][[pval_column]] <= 0.05, ]
    # filter for only the positive lfc if required
    if(only_positive){
      de_table <- de_table[de_table[[lfc_column]] < 0, ]
    }
    # filter for only the positive lfc if required
    if(only_negative){
      de_table <- de_table[de_table[[lfc_column]] > 0, ]
    }
    # we just care about the gene names
    sig_genes <- NULL
    if (is.null(feature_column)) {
      sig_genes <- rownames(mast)
    }
    else {
      sig_genes <- de_table[[feature_column]]
    }
    # store these for the cell type
    DE_genes_per_ct[[cell_type]] <- sig_genes
  }
  if(use_label_dict){
    names(DE_genes_per_ct) <- rename_labels(names(DE_genes_per_ct))
  }
  queries <- list()
  sets.bar.color <- 'black'
  if(use_color_dict){
    # create df to store the number of each set, so we know how to order
    nrs_df <- NULL
    # add the colors for the cell types
    for(i in 1:length(names(DE_genes_per_ct))){
      cell_type <- names(DE_genes_per_ct)[i]
      # add for the singles in the intersection sizes
      ct_list <- list(
        query = intersects,
        params = list(cell_type),
        color = get_color_coding_dict()[[cell_type]],
        active = T)
      queries[[i]] <- ct_list
      # add for the DF to order the set sizes
      numbers_row <- data.frame(ct=c(cell_type), nr=c(length(DE_genes_per_ct[[cell_type]])), stringsAsFactors = F)
      if(is.null(nrs_df)){
        nrs_df <- numbers_row
      }
      else{
        nrs_df <- rbind(nrs_df, numbers_row)
      }
    }
    # get the order of the sets
    ordered_cts <- nrs_df[order(nrs_df$nr, decreasing = T), 'ct']
    # add the colors for the sets
    sets.bar.color <- unlist(get_color_coding_dict()[ordered_cts])
    upset(fromList(DE_genes_per_ct), order.by = 'freq', nsets = length(DE_genes_per_ct), queries = queries, sets.bar.color=sets.bar.color)
  }
  else {
    upset(fromList(DE_genes_per_ct), order.by = 'freq', nsets = length(DE_genes_per_ct))
  }
  
  #return(DE_genes_per_ct)
}
